description: Read the clinical note of a session. Non-restricted notes return full content. Notes marked dataSensitivity=restricted return metadata only (type, sensitivity, timestamps, which fields are present) with the clinical text withheld — pass includeRestricted: true to retrieve the full content, which logs an audited restricted-access event and increments the access counter. Returns note: null if the session has no note.
name: session_note_get
